summary: Iteration 20 focused on (a) admin discoverability fix for Guest Photos queue and (b) gold-R monogram logo rollout. All targeted flows PASS. Public header/footer/mobile-drawer/payment-success/admin-console/admin-manage logos load correct assets. Admin login lands on /admin, new 'admin-nav-gallery' quick-link is visible with a pending-count badge that increments after a POST /api/gallery/submit and decrements after approve. Clicking the quick-link navigates to /admin/manage?tab=gallery, the GalleryPanel is rendered, and URL/tab sync works both directions (?tab=tours after clicking Tours, and reload preserves the tab). Public GET /api/gallery returns approved photos with category='guests'. Favicon /logo-mark.png returns 200 image/png and index.html <link rel='icon'> points to it. Backend pytest suite from iter_19 not re-run per request (no backend changes).
critical_code_review_comments: Unauthenticated calls to /admin/gallery/pending (and other admin endpoints) run on the public /admin/login page and produce noisy 401s in the browser console. Not a functional bug, but consider gating those fetches behind an auth check to keep the console clean and avoid unnecessary network traffic.
seed_data_creation: Submitted 1 test guest photo via POST /api/gallery/submit (id=a7c956e5827c) then approved via admin UI. It now appears in public GET /api/gallery under category='guests' (total guests=3).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Logo rollout and admin Guest-Photos discoverability are verified end-to-end. Static assets /logo-gold.webp, /logo-white.webp, /logo-mark.png all serve 200 with correct MIME. Badge behavior: shows count only when >0 pending, count increments on submit and decrements on approve/reject. URL tab-sync in AdminManage confirmed for gallery↔tours transitions and survives reload. /receipt/{bookingId} logo not visually verified this run (no confirmed booking id fetched) — implementation inspection covers it; flag if a booking becomes available later.
